source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 10 februarie — «Sfântul Mucenic Pavel»

attestations.note: doxologia.ro keeps a second Romanian day for him, 18 iulie, «Sfântul Mucenic Pavel», where the calendar prints him beside a Valentina and sends both to one shared life of two sentences: «Sfinții Pavel şi Valentina au suferit moarte martirică pentru Mântuitorul nostru Iisus Hristos, în anul 308, deoarece nu au vrut să jertfească idolilor.» The pair of names and the year 308 are those of the Caesarea martyrs of 10 februarie, so the 18 iulie lines are read as the same two and are recorded here as a note rather than as a second feast row; he does not render on 18 iulie. The 18 iulie page gives no place, no judge and no troparion, so nothing there settles the identification beyond the names and the year. Ennatha is not printed on 18 iulie. Read 24 September 2026 at https://doxologia.ro/18-iulie and https://doxologia.ro/viata-sfintilor-mucenici-pavel-valentina.
